source: Hyderabad Food Safety Authority — FOOD SAFETY AUDIT CHECKLIST.xlsx (owner-supplied 2026-10-13)
read_from: The .xlsx itself, every sheet, row by row — the text of column A and the cell STYLE of each row, which is the only thing that tells a heading from a line (every row, headings included, has YES / NO / REMARK cells). Regenerated 2026-10-14 by the pack-and-excel lane; FSSAI_HYD_WORKBOOK in src/lib/fssai-checklist-pack.ts holds the same rows and is proved against the file.

numbering_note: sections[].items[] keeps the 120 entries, in the order and with the numbers (#1–#120) every earlier coverage report uses. 119 of them are lines; #57 "Kitchen" is the sub-heading over the kitchen cleaning lines and has no answer of its own. Of the 119 lines, 99 are the walk-through, asked word for word by CHK-HYD-AUDIT-1/2/3 (see asked_by), and 20 are "Records You Should Keep Ready in One Audit File", held by the Audit File page (audit_file_record = AUDIT_FILE_RECORDS n).
corrections_2026_10_14: authority_pages: CHECKLIST 1 holds all seven Food Temperature Control lines (Receiving … Cooling) and no Cleaning & Sanitation line. The previous file said 5 temperature lines and 2 cleaning lines.
authority_pages: CHECKLIST 3 is headed "FOH" (4 lines) and "Washrooms" (5 lines), not "Cleaning & Sanitation" (9).
authority_pages: CHECKLIST 2 has 30 lines, not 31 — "Kitchen" is a sub-heading on the sheet, not a line.
sections_note: sections[] is the 11 groups of the original summary, kept for its #1-#120 numbering. The workbook itself has 13 headings on the master sheet: "FOH" and "Washrooms" are headings of their own, not part of "Cleaning & Sanitation" — see each item's "heading" and workbook[] for the sheet exactly as it is.
